description_en: Reports the delivery status of each message (by MessageId) to the Alibaba Cloud international SMS platform
description_zh: 将每一条消息ID(MessageId) 对应短信的接收情况反馈给阿里云国际短信平台
name: SmsConversionIntl

parameters.help_en: Set to true if your user replied to the message you sent. Otherwise, set to false
parameters.help_zh: 如果您的用户回复了您发送的消息，则设置为 true。否则，设置为 false
parameters.name: delivered

parameters.help_en:
The timestamp when the message reached the target. The value must be a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds (long integer).

If you do not specify this field: The current timestamp is used by default.

If you specify this field: The timestamp must be later than the send time and earlier than the current timestamp
parameters.help_zh:
触达发送目标的时间戳。必须是Unix时间戳，毫秒级别长整型。

如果不指定该字段：默认当前的时间戳。

如果指定该字段：该时间戳必须大于发送时间并且小于当前时间戳
parameters.name: conversion_time

Code.description_en: The status code. OK indicates that the request was successful. For other error codes, see Error codes (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html?spm=a2c4g.101345.0.0.74326ff2J5EZyt)
Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回OK代表请求成功，其他错误码，请参见错误码列表 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html?spm=a2c4g.101345.0.0.74326ff2J5EZyt)
